context: Two managers prep a public-relations brief
purpose: Teach: 地盤/町長/奨学/実名/前編/メーター/パッチ/ならびに

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広報文の地盤固め、町長コメントは取れた?
lines.en: The PR groundwork — did you get the mayor's comment?
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Quick upbeat tempo. No waste. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with confidence. Sharp intake before speaking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。奨学金制度、実名で受給者紹介、了承済みです。
lines.en: Yes. The scholarship program — beneficiaries named and consent secured.
lines.style: Straightforward, no embellishment. Even pacing. Professional assurance without inflection-seeking. Reports the fact cleanly and waits.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 動画の前編、編集に出した?
lines.en: Video part one — you sent it to the editors?
lines.style: Rapid-fire, task-oriented. Slight uptick at the end — checking a box. No pause for elaboration. Moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。流量メーター、ならびに新パッチ、現場確認済み。
lines.en: Yes. The flow-meter and the new patch both verified on-site.
lines.style: Same steady composure. Slightly fuller breath — pride in field work done. Concrete details delivered without ceremony. Reliable confidence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet, satisfied exhale. Soft finality. The closing note — no performance, just earned quiet certainty. Barely above a whisper.
